referenceSources.title: Sold | 1992 Citroen AX GTi
referenceSources.description:
A 1992 Citroën AX GTi in Onyx Black is presented in a head‑on shot, parked on a quiet road with dense foliage in the background. The compact hot hatch displays its characteristic double‑chevron grille, rectangular headlights—one illuminated—and matching black plastic bumpers and wheel arches. A red placeholder covers the front license plate area, emphasizing the car’s clean lines and sporty stance.

This model, offered on 27 October 2025 by Collecting Cars, is powered by a 1.4‑litre naturally aspirated inline‑four engine mated to a five‑speed manual gearbox. Although the odometer was reset after an instrument cluster failure in 2017, the total mileage is estimated at around 108,500 km. The exterior shows moderate wear, including clear coat cracks and a repaint, and the car is rated 6/10 for condition but remains in good running order.
